Index.title: Your First Connection in Korea
Index.subtitle: Navigate the maze of Korean mobile plans. No ARC yet? No Korean bank? We'll find the exact SIM or eSIM plan you can get today.
Index.catch22_desc: You need a Korean phone number to get a bank account. But you need a bank account (and ARC) to get a phone plan. Sound familiar?
Index.catch22_pay_desc: Crypto (USDC), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal
Index.apps_desc: The essential apps you must download before landing.
Index.kakao_desc: The undisputed king of messaging in Korea. 99% of the population uses it. You cannot survive without it.
Index.naver_desc: Google Maps doesn't work well for walking or driving in Korea due to security laws. Get Naver Map.
Index.papago_desc: Better translation for Korean-English than Google Translate. Crucial for reading menus and signs.
Index.subway_desc: The most accurate subway navigation app. Covers Seoul, Busan, Daegu and more.

Result.title: Your Perfect Match
Result.subtitle: Based on your situation, here are the exact routes you should take.
Result.unlock_desc: Get a step-by-step guide including store locations, checklist, and a Korean script to show the clerk.
Result.unlock_secure: Secure payment via Gumroad. Supports credit cards, Apple Pay worldwide.
Result.dynamic_meaning_primary: This is the absolute best plan. We simulated your exact stay duration against all promo and regular prices down to the exact KRW, proving this is the cheapest total cost for you.
Result.dynamic_meaning_alt: A viable alternative option considering your selected stay duration.
Result.plan_esim_why1: Provides instant data connection right after you land.
Result.plan_esim_why2: Does not provide a Korean 010 number, so identity verification is impossible.
Result.plan_esim_why3: Best for filling the gap before you get a proper SIM.
Result.plan_prepaid_airport_why1: Can be activated instantly using only your passport.
Result.plan_prepaid_airport_why2: Great when you urgently need a Korean number right after arriving.
Result.plan_prepaid_airport_why3: More expensive, but the most convenient option.
Result.plan_prepaid_online_why1: Requires only a passport and is much cheaper than airport options.
Result.plan_prepaid_online_why2: Perfect for temporary use while waiting for your ARC.
Result.plan_prepaid_online_why3: Can be paid with foreign cards or cash (at convenience stores).
Result.plan_major_why1: Best if you need to buy a new device on an installment plan.
Result.plan_major_why2: Offers face-to-face consultation and foreign language support.
Result.plan_major_why3: More expensive than MVNOs, and watch out for contract cancellation fees.
Result.plan_mvno_why1: The final destination for expats with an ARC and Korean bank account.
Result.plan_mvno_why2: 50-70% cheaper than major carriers with the exact same network quality.
Result.plan_mvno_why3: Usually no-contract, so you can cancel anytime.
Result.generate_sheet_desc: A summary document in Korean you can just show to the store clerk.
